Turnover measures total shares relative to an external tradable-share denominator and is invariant to minute occupancy. Campaign105 measures only how many fixed clock intervals contain a trade and is invariant to total positive activity scale.

Campaign105 makes no inference about trade or order size. Aggregate positive activity directly identifies that at least one trade contributed to the minute, which the accepted volume/amount schema supports.
